text.style: fill: #1d1d1f; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: service in April and May 2023: 187 segments (about 1.4%) reliably produced invented text; 312 transcriptions contained it (roughly 1%).

text.style: fill: #1d1d1f; font: 9.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Categories overlap, so 19 + 13 + 8 is more than 38. In December 2023, after updates, 12 of the 187 segments still did.
